route_results.reason: The proposed record is a project-specific statutory clearance lifecycle combined with stop-work, mitigation and resumption stages. Campaign179 and Campaign200 already freeze those permit and project-execution primitives; choosing a heritage authority, asset class, geography or clearance stage would be a subtype rescue.

Collective bargaining and labor-dispute lifecycle state is distinct from workforce composition, productivity and a generic operating interruption, but the repository has no admitted 2019-2023 point-in-time contract covering bargaining units, listed issuers and material subsidiaries, agreement versions, negotiations, strikes, mediation, settlements, expiry, corrections, first-public timing and the complete applicable-market zero/missing denominator.

Product approval, formulary or procurement inclusion and payer reimbursement are already frozen milestone, contract-award and reimbursement lifecycles. Selecting a product, tender program, price adjustment, payer, renewal or removal stage would combine or subset terminal mechanisms.

Water withdrawal rights, discharge permits, allocations, curtailments, renewal and revocation are regulated-right and environmental-compliance states already frozen by Campaign179 and Campaign165. Geography, unit, right type or threshold cannot rescue the route.

Livestock mortality, culling and replacement are frozen by Campaign191, incident interruption and recovery by Campaign166, and quarantine, recall and corrective action by Campaign215. Species, disease, jurisdiction or recovery-stage choices are cohort and source-family variants.

Campaign180 explicitly freezes export-control licensing, end-use scope, entity-list designation, restriction, exemption, removal and appeal. A jurisdiction, controlled item, end user or event-stage variant is an exact mechanism rescue.

Product registration and certification are frozen by Campaign167, certificate lifecycle by Campaign221, and energy or environmental state by Campaign165. Label scheme, grade, product category, validity window or suspension stage is not a new primitive.

decision.reason: Six routes duplicate immutable terminal mechanisms and the only economically distinct route lacks a complete lawful point-in-time source contract. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign279 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign280 may freeze a new genuinely independent finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign279 or earlier route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.
